Affordable app development for iOS and Android

We build one app for iPhone and Android at the same time, at a fixed price agreed up front. An MVP starts at €3,150 and a complete app with accounts and a database at €6,750.

Our app packages

PackageIncludesFrom

Why we cost less

We use one codebase for both platforms, proven building blocks and a lot of automation. That saves hours, and you see the savings in the price.

Running costs

Apple charges $99 per year and Google $25 once. Hosting for small apps is often free to $25 per month. Maintenance is optional from €85.50 per month. All of this is listed in your quote.

See it before you pay

After a short intake by email we make a free clickable concept of 1–3 screens, so you can see we can really build it.

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with clients outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere, with no VAT added. Time zones are rarely a problem: most of the work is done in writing, and calls are planned at a time that suits you.

How do I pay?

For apps, in three parts: 40% when you approve the quote, 40% when you approve the test version and 20% on delivery. That way you never pay everything up front and always see results first. For smaller jobs, such as a website or automation, the payment terms are stated in the quote. All prices are final prices in euros.

Who owns the code and the app?

After the final payment the source code is transferred to you and the app is published on your own Apple and Google developer accounts. That means the app, its reviews and its users always stay with you. If you later want to work with another developer, you can continue without starting over.

How long does it take?

A Basic app takes 3–5 weeks, a Standard app 6–10 weeks and a Custom app 10–16 weeks or more. After that, Apple and Google review the app, which usually takes a few days. You get a schedule up front and test versions along the way, so you can see progress and steer in time.
